E5: "70% mid stenosis" -> Spinal stenosis (ICD10CM M480) -> Orthopaedics
E6: "70% mid stenosis" -> aortic stenosis  -> Cardiothoracic Surgery
E7: "Triple vessel disease" -> Hemarthrosis (ICD10CM M250) -> Orthopaedics
E8: "Triple vessel disease" -> triple vessel disease  -> Cardiothoracic Surgery
E9: "CORONARY ANGIOGRAPHY" -> aortic stenosis  -> Cardiothoracic Surgery
E10: "CABG" -> cabg  -> Cardiothoracic Surgery

- "choice" must be one of the candidates above, or "unclear".
- "evidence" lists the IDs of the evidence lines that support your choice (at least one).
- "patient_quote" copies the exact words from the patient text that decided it.
